name: Being Overweight
overview: Scripture warns against being controlled by appetite and earthly desires, as seen in Proverbs 23:2 and Philippians 3:19, where indulgence in the flesh is linked to spiritual destruction. Believers are encouraged to exercise self-control and not be anxious about physical needs (Luke 12:29), while showing gentleness and longsuffering as fruit of the Spirit (Galatians 5:22). The call is to trust God’s provision and to receive those weak in faith without judgment (Romans 14:1), recognizing that true prosperity is found in obedience rather than indulgence (Jeremiah 22:21).
